name: Apple Dev
tagline: Runs Xcode, simulators and Swift builds on a Mac you have connected
description: Aimed at people whose work has to compile on Apple hardware. Point it at a machine you have already paired, by its identifier, and it drives the local toolchain sitting there — editor, build, simulator — so the iOS or macOS side of a project is handled from chat rather than by hand.

source.excerpt: Shared as the bridge between a chat assistant and real Apple tooling on your own Mac.

body:
## What it does

Aimed at people whose work has to compile on Apple hardware. Point it at a machine you have already paired, by its identifier, and it drives the local toolchain sitting there — editor, build, simulator — so the iOS or macOS side of a project is handled from chat rather than by hand. It runs when you ask it to, rather than on a timer.

## Before you install

Open the share link and read the instructions it carries before you add it. @Baconbrix shared this one publicly, and adding it copies the setup into your own account rather than giving you access to theirs.
